title: G7 countries plan “tabletop exercises” simulating AI cyberattacks on banks.
summary: The drills were confirmed by Japan’s finance minister on Thursday. States and organizations have grown increasingly worried about AI’s ability to supercharge hacking , particularly after months of impressive releases and rogue agent attacks .
